title: Project Coordinator & Planner
description:
Job Description: Turnkey Fit-Out Project Coordinator & Planner

**Company Name:** AD Square Projects India Private Limited  
**Industry:** Interior Fit-Out & Turnkey Projects  
**Job Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Department:** Project Management  
**Experience:** 2–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Project Coordinator & Planner to manage the planning, scheduling, coordination, and execution of turnkey interior fit-out projects. The candidate will coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, vendors, contractors, and internal teams to ensure projects are completed within the approved timelines, budget, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Project Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare detailed project schedules, work plans, and execution timelines.
* Develop and monitor project schedules using MS Project, Primavera P6, or Excel.
* Plan activities for civil, interior, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire-fighting, and other MEP works.
* Track project progress against planned milestones and identify delays.
* Prepare weekly and monthly project progress reports.

**2. Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with site engineers, project managers, architects, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Conduct project review meetings and follow up on pending activities.
* Ensure timely availability of drawings, materials, manpower, and equipment.
* Coordinate between design, procurement, billing, and execution teams.
* Follow up on client approvals, material approvals, and shop drawings.

**3. Site Progress Monitoring**

* Monitor daily site progress and ensure execution follows the approved schedule.
* Identify project bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions.
* Track work completion, dependencies, and critical activities.
* Conduct site visits when required to review progress and resolve coordination issues.

**4. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain project schedules, trackers, MOMs (Minutes of Meeting), and daily/weekly progress reports.
* Maintain drawing registers, material approval trackers, and RFI logs.
* Prepare delay reports, look-ahead schedules, and project status updates.
* Maintain proper records of project-related correspondence and approvals.

**5. Cost & Resource Coordination**

* Coordinate with procurement and billing teams to ensure timely material delivery and work execution.
* Monitor resource utilization and report potential cost or schedule overruns.
* Support project managers in cost control, billing coordination, and variation tracking.
* Ensure project activities are aligned with contractual requirements and client expectations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in project coordination and planning, preferably in commercial interior fit-out or turnkey projects.
* Strong knowledge of interior fit-out execution, civil works, and MEP coordination.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Project; knowledge of Primavera P6 is an advantage.
* Good understanding of project scheduling, critical path, and progress tracking.
* Excellent coordination, communication, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet strict deadlines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in commercial offices, corporate interiors, retail spaces, and turnkey fit-out projects.
* Ability to coordinate multiple teams and handle project priorities effectively.
* Strong follow-up skills and a proactive approach to resolving delays.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with their current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

**Email:** hr@adsprojects.in  
**Website:** www.adsprojects.in

**Join AD Square Projects India Private Limited and contribute to delivering quality turnkey interior fit-out projects on time.**

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

TCE serves domestic as well as international markets and is known for several first-of-its-kind projects offering Engineering Studies, Design Engineering Services, Project Management Consultancy Services, OPEX and IIOT across all three verticals. A part of Tata Group - India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.

**Purpose & Scope of Position**
-------------------------------

The Contracts Specialist is responsible for managing the contractual aspects of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with all terms and conditions, and facilitating smooth project execution. This role involves drafting, negotiating, and administering contracts while working closely with project teams, clients, and suppliers. The incumbent leads a team of contract specialists and has vital responsibilities in carrying a project to an on-time, on-budget completion. He/She is the owner of the entire contracting process, both pre and post award activities. The responsibilities include negotiating the terms and conditions in contracts and ensuring compliance with the terms and conditions, including documenting and agreeing on any changes that may arise during its implementation or execution. The role involves systematically and efficiently managing contract formation, execution/administration, and analysis for the purpose of maximizing financial, scope and schedule related performance and minimizing risk.

**Experience**
--------------

• A minimum of 15 years relevant experience with minimum of 10 years relevant experience in Contracts. • Prior experience with Design-Build and professional services contracts is required with advanced knowledge of Design Build contract risks and interpretations, including Progressive Design Build.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* Graduate or Post-Graduate in Engineering with Master's degree in Business Administration or Contracts Management credentials, preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. Provide leadership to the Contract Management function including pre-award Procurement, Contract Administration, claims management / dispute resolution, and contract close-out for piling related contracts. 2. Organizing and chairing of all regular commercial meetings, ensuring actions are clearly recorded and regularly updating their status, to ensure Subcontractor’s adherence to the Contract terms under which the Subcontract is administered and any supporting addendums 3. Review of Periodic Reports issued by the EM/PM, confirming accuracy of information, adherence to the Contract terms and any other agreements, and regularly assessing progress against the latest accepted schedule 4. Review and preparation of Change Certificates. seeking signatories for approval of changes, in accordance with project’s Levels of Authority Matrix. 5. Sharing of information in relation to payment, schedule, risk and scope change to the wider commercial team (finance, cost, project controls, prime contract) on a monthly basis or as dictated by the Prime Contract, and to the wider project team as requested 6. Develops, revises, negotiates, and administers contracts, bids, and proposals that meet specifications (in coordination with the business) from proposal stage to project close-out in accordance with relevant regulations and best commercial practice. 7. Advise the Leadership Team on all contractual matters and claims requiring escalation. Provides advice on and interpretation of contract requirements and risk mitigation strategies. 8. Leads the development of internal contract team by providing guidance and work leadership to less-experienced contracts/subcontracts administrators and managers. 9. Attend Contractor and Consultant progress meetings as required. 10. Review of tender documents in respect of contractual matters, scope gaps and discrepancies and managing the closure of these matters as required. 11. Participate on Commercial Evaluation Panel during the procurement process. 12. Provide formal written reports on the Contracts and Procurement status and issues to management.

title: Technical Program Manager – Funding & Payments
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** We are looking to recruit a Program Manager to lead delivery across our Funding and Payments portfolio, based out of our Pune, India office. The successful candidate will have previous experience leading complex, large-scale technical program deliveries spanning multiple geographies, business units and platforms, ideally across client funding, cash management and payments.

Working closely with the EPMO, Payments and Treasury leadership, Product, Technology, Operations and third-party providers, you will drive delivery of a strategic, multi-year portfolio of funding and payments initiatives. This includes the Funding as a Service (FaaS) program, which brings client funding, cash management, and ACH authorization and entitlements to commercial, introducing broker and newly integrated client bases, alongside Global Payments initiatives such as real-time payment (RTP) currencies through correspondent banks, a payment status and tracking engine, cross-currency accounts and operations automation. Much of the payments development capacity sits in India, so you will play a central role in keeping those teams aligned to firm-wide priorities. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, challenging and collaborative working environment and who is results-driven.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

Driving overall delivery of a strategic program of work across Funding and Payments. Your role is to define the different stages of implementation and ensure they are met. Your main roles and responsibilities will be as follows, but are not limited to:

* Work with Payments, Treasury, Product, commercial teams and senior stakeholders to identify program scope and objectives across the funding and payments lifecycle – client funding, payment initiation, authorization, routing, execution, confirmation, reconciliation and reporting
* Work with delivery teams and solution architects to build out agreed scope, define requirements and build robust plans for delivery across payment channels and rails, including ACH, wires/SWIFT, real-time payments and correspondent banking
* Define the projects and features that make up the program, bringing consensus to the most efficient way to deliver value to the organization as quickly as possible
* Monitor and assess program performance, overseeing delivery of the projects and features that make up the program, ensuring completion on time, to scope and within budget
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring everyone on the program is clear on what needs to happen, when it needs to happen by, how it is going to happen and who by
* Identify, track and monitor dependencies across shared payments development teams, dependent programs (such as CRM, client onboarding and trading platform launches) and downstream Operations and Treasury teams
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, correspondent and partner banks, payment service providers and other third-party vendors, ensuring alignment of business, operational and technology outcomes
* Secure resource commitment and hold teams to account, applying the firm’s portfolio prioritization framework to resolve competing demands on shared development capacity quickly and transparently
* Identify high-level risks and issues and track them through to resolution, escalating promptly to sponsors where priority or resourcing conflicts put milestones at risk
* Partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology to ensure regulatory and control requirements, such as payment authorization, entitlements and audit trails, are embedded in delivery
* Own program financials: report spend to date (hrs and $) against budget, forecast to completion, and raise change and funding requests when scope or dependencies shift
* Clearly, concisely and accurately communicate program progress, RAG status, risks and decisions at regular intervals to sponsors, working groups and steering committees across the US, UK and Europe
* Build relationships with stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors and EPMO team members, acting as the EPMO’s on-the-ground delivery lead in Pune
* Identify, address and resolve differences between individuals and/or interest groups

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need**:

* **7+ years of full-time program management experience or equivalent**
* **Proven success delivering large and complex change initiatives at program level, ideally in financial services and with budgets of over $2m / 10,000 person days**
* **Knowledge of payments and cash management is a must, including ACH and Stable Coin.**
* **Familiarity with payment platforms and messaging, such as payment hubs, payment status and tracking solutions, SWIFT and ISO 20022, or comparable treasury and cash management systems**
* Comfortable working with internal teams of 50+ people across multiple geographies and time zones, with regular overlap with UK and US business hours
* A key collaborator – inclusive, results-driven, who leads by example and brings the best out of teams
* Ability to work with people, both internally and externally, to build support to achieve intended outcomes
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and financial services preferred; exposure to futures, brokerage or FCM client funding would be an advantage
* Direct experience working with IT development teams, platforms and solution architects
* Ability to quickly adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Strong leadership qualities with the capability to manage diverse teams
* Ability to master and navigate new subject domains quickly
* Confident in communicating with C-suites and technical delivery teams
* Experience in Jira and Confluence, Agile and Waterfall
* A background in business analysis would be an advantage.
* The role will be based in the Pune, India office 4 days per week
* A professional qualification in project / program management (e.g., PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 or MSP) is preferred
* **Candidates based in Pune location is preferred**

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' a week in office.
